verdict.rationale: Previews are a fair axis for a cloud file-storage API, but the pack never documents API-served thumbnails or embeddable document previews. It covers uploads, sharing permissions, search, custom properties and push notifications only. The generic 'metadata for a file' reference does not show preview or thumbnail support.

support.subject: As a developer, previews are an API call — thumbnails and embeddable document previews served for common formats without me rendering them
